newsitem.title: FRANCE: GOLF-PARNEVIK MUST RELY ON WILDCARD FOR RYDER CUP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PARNEVIK MUST RELY ON WILDCARD FOR RYDER CUP.

text.p: Sweden's Jesper Parnevik will not be eligible for an automatic place in September's Ryder Cup after declining to rejoin the European Tour, an official said on Friday.
European Tour executive director Ken Schofield said Parnevik's decision to compete solely on the U.S. Tour restricted his chances of making the European team for the Cup in Valderrama.
Schofield said the Swedish player's only chance rested with Ryder Cup captain Seve Ballesteros who could issue two wildcard places in the team.

"The reality now is that the only way Jesper will get into the Ryder Cup team is by way of one of the two wildcards. And, of course, they are at Seve's behest," said Schofield, speaking at the Cannes Open.
Parnevik, 32, was runner-up at the 1994 British Open and is currently fourth on the U.S. money winners list.
